title: Vingean reflection in miniature: does a weak verifier trust a stronger model it cannot fully check?

original_idea.body:
# Weak Verifier Trusting a Stronger Model

Weak model spot-checks a stronger model's steps; vary verifiable fraction and honesty, measure accept/reject accuracy.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: turns a trust/oversight problem into a concrete weak-verifier experiment connecting to recursive verification.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Weak-verifier accept/reject setup on open models, vary verifiability; clear methodology.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open models, inference-only, scalable-oversight verification valuable.

novelty.reasoning: Weak-verifier/scalable-oversight setups exist; the Vingean-framed verifiability sweep may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Weak-verifier oversight is studied; the Vingean-framed verifiability sweep may be open.
